author: macro-strategist-cyrus-daruwalla
description: Breadth THRUST (momentum of breadth, not level): 3-month change in market_state.breadth_pct_above_200dma (already on disk, built from cube_close_long.parquet, 2005-2025). Distinguished from the existing breadth LEVEL already consumed by the validated s_mkt exposure scalar in ABSOLUTE_SCORER_SPEC -- this tests whether the RATE OF CHANGE of breadth carries incremental information the level scalar does not.
data: ALPHA_RANKER/rnd/panel/market_state.parquet breadth_pct_above_200dma (built off rnd/panel/cube_close_long.parquet, 976 names, 2005-2025). Forward targets from EW-cube proxy index.

dropone_bear.note: all 3 bears reachable, longest history of the new gauges alongside credit spread and buffett

interpretation: [INFERENCE/OPINION] Consistently the WEAKEST-magnitude gauge in the battery on every axis, but also one of only two (with credit spread) that is sign-stable on BOTH era-split and all-3-bear drop-one -- a genuinely boring, low-drama, dependable signal rather than a powerful-but-fragile one. Its best relative showing is crash-risk (maxdd corr 0.167), better than the plain valuation-band's -0.088 (wrong-signed) though weaker than the Buffett indicator's 0.489. A classic Zweig-style discrete 10-day-threshold thrust flag (from <40% to >61.5% breadth in 10 trading days) was considered but not built in this pass -- it would be a sparse, few-dozen-occurrence-over-20-years event flag, too low-n on its own to test meaningfully within this task's low-t discipline; the continuous 3-month breadth-change version tested here is the more usable soft input for an M-adjacent ensemble.
overall_verdict: BUILDABLE, WEAK but ROBUST (passes both era-split and drop-one cleanly) -- best used as a low-weight stabilizing ingredient in an ensemble (as tested in W4MAC_ensemble_vs_valband) rather than a standalone signal. Complements the already-validated breadth LEVEL/s_mkt scalar; does not replace it.
confidence: MEDIUM-HIGH on the sign-stability finding (long history, clean drop-one, plausible mechanism -- accelerating participation modestly favors continuation); LOW on standalone usefulness given the small magnitude.
